verdict.rationale:
Jules explicitly lets users submit a plain-language task (or GitHub issue via label), then generates a plan the user reviews/approves before any code changes, effectively turning intent into a scoped implementation task with a diff and PR at the end. Community reports corroborate that this workflow produces real, usable PRs in practice (though quality varies by task complexity).
missing for 10: no independent benchmark showing plan scoping accuracy/quality across task types, and community reports show inconsistent execution quality requiring rework.
